hints.text: Dividing by a fraction asks how many pieces of that size fit inside the first number. Picture cutting each whole into thirds.
One whole holds $3$ thirds. There are $4$ wholes, so count the thirds with $4 \times 3$.
$4 \times 3 = 12$, so $4 \div \frac{1}{3} = 12$ because twelve thirds fit in four wholes.

explanation: $4 \div \frac{1}{3}$ asks how many pieces of size $\frac{1}{3}$ fit into $4$ wholes.
Each whole can be cut into exactly $3$ thirds, so every whole gives $3$ pieces.
Four wholes give $4 \times 3 = 12$ pieces, so the quotient $4 \div \frac{1}{3}$ is $12$.
